flags_for_sean: ch 378 'Orochi Nest/The Snake's Lair': Episode 168's infobox + animefillerguide place it in ep 168, but Chapter 378's own page maps it to ep 169. Kept in ep 168 (2 sources vs 1); it is a single-scene fragment either way.
